# Rock de Vocht

## Biography
Rock de Vocht is a New Zealand-based full-stack software developer focusing on web and backend systems.

## Technical know how
- Rock has a large set of skills and is a full stack developer.  
- Rock is well versed in Terraform, SQL, Big Data, Apache Spark, C#, C++, C, Java, Kotlin, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Apache Cassandra.

## Key Open Source Projects
- Rock's full Java based PDF redaction library https://github.com/rock3125/pdf-redaction
- Rock's high performance C and Kotlin data structures https://github.com/rock3125/rock-datastructures
- Rock's entertaining retro web game, gravity-force X https://github.com/rock3125/gforcex-js
